title: Yeni Ürün Oluşturma
prompt: Login to backoffice with username {{credentials.backoffice.username}} and password {{credentials.backoffice.password}}. Navigate to Products section. Click 'Add New Product' or similar button. Fill in the product name with 'Test Ürün {{commonData.testName}}', add a description, set a price of 99.99. Save the product. Verify it appears in the product list.
expectedOutcome: New product is created and appears in the product list

title: Kullanıcı Filtreleme
prompt: Login to backoffice with username {{credentials.backoffice.username}} and password {{credentials.backoffice.password}}. Navigate to Users section. Look for filter or search options. Filter users by status 'Active' if available. Verify the list updates based on the filter.
expectedOutcome: User list is filtered and shows relevant results

title: Sipariş Detay Görüntüleme
prompt: Login to backoffice with username {{credentials.backoffice.username}} and password {{credentials.backoffice.password}}. Navigate to Orders section. Click on the first order in the list. Verify that the order detail page shows order information, customer details, and order items.
expectedOutcome: Order detail page is visible with complete order information

title: Pagination Kontrolü
prompt: Login to backoffice with username {{credentials.backoffice.username}} and password {{credentials.backoffice.password}}. Navigate to Orders section. If pagination controls are visible, click on page 2 or 'Next' button. Verify the list updates to show the next page of results.
expectedOutcome: Pagination works and navigates to the next page of results

title: Admin Signs In to Backoffice — Happy Path (Regression)
prompt: Navigate to ${BACKOFFICE_URL}/authentication/sign-in/. Verify page loads with HTTP 200. Verify the left-side decorative image is present (non-zero dimensions, src not broken). Verify 'Giriş' heading is visible within 3s. Verify 'Giriş için email ve şifrenizi giriniz' subtitle is visible. Enter {{credentials.backoffice.username}} in the Email field. Enter {{credentials.backoffice.password}} in the Password field — verify type is 'password' and characters are masked. Click show/hide toggle: verify input switches to type='text'. Click toggle again: verify input returns to type='password'. Click 'Giriş'. Verify redirect to dashboard (sign-in URL is NOT the final URL). Verify no error banner is shown. Verify [data-testid='login-page'] is no longer visible.
expectedOutcome: Admin is redirected to dashboard. Page elements (Giriş heading, subtitle, decorative image) are all correctly rendered. Password toggle works in both directions. No error banner post-login. Sign-in page is no longer shown.
tcContext: TC-BO-009: Admin signs in to Backoffice with valid credentials. Full regression check including UI element verification, left-side image render, password toggle both directions, and post-login assertions. Fixture: FIXTURE-USER-ADMIN-001. Precondition: SHARED-PRE-002. API: POST /identity/auth/token.

title: Dealer-Owner Role Blocked from Backoffice (Regression)
prompt: Navigate to ${BACKOFFICE_URL}/authentication/sign-in/. Enter ${TEST_VENDOR_EMAIL} in the Email field. Enter ${TEST_VENDOR_PASSWORD} in the Password field. Click 'Giriş'. Verify login is rejected: URL remains on ${BACKOFFICE_URL}/authentication/sign-in/ (ER-1). Verify a visible error banner or inline message is displayed — e.g. 'Bu hesap backoffice'e erişim iznine sahip değil' or equivalent (ER-2). Verify the backoffice dashboard URL is never reached and no authenticated session is created (ER-3). Verify the page does NOT remain blank or in an infinite spinner (ER-4). Also verify via direct API: POST /identity/auth/token with dealer credentials must deny backoffice scope.
expectedOutcome: Dealer-owner is blocked. Error message is visible (ER-2). URL stays on sign-in (ER-1). No dashboard access or session created (ER-3). Page is responsive — no blank or infinite spinner (ER-4). API denies backoffice scope.
tcContext: TC-BO-010: Dealer-owner role is blocked from accessing Backoffice. Full regression check with all 4 assertion conditions. Fixture: FIXTURE-USER-VENDOR-001. API: POST /identity/auth/token. Also validates EC-2 (direct API token request with dealer credentials).
